targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM product_events
WHERE event_type = 'user_registered'
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date;

WITH sent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, job_id
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'notification_sent'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), feedback AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, job_id
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'feedback_submitted'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.user_id IS NOT NULL)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::double precision,
  0
) AS value
FROM sent
LEFT JOIN feedback USING (user_id, job_id);

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM product_events
WHERE event_type = 'profile_completed'
  AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS registrations
FROM product_events
WHERE event_type = 'user_registered'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

WITH sent AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, job_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(source, ''), 'unknown') AS source
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'notification_sent'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), feedback AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, job_id, COALESCE(properties->>'feedback', '') AS feedback
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'feedback_submitted'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
SELECT
  sent.source,
  COUNT(*)::bigint AS notifications_sent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback <> '')::bigint AS feedback_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback = 'good')::bigint AS good_feedback,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback = 'bad')::bigint AS bad_feedback,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback <> '')::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::double precision, 0) AS feedback_conversion,
  COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback = 'good')::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE feedback.feedback <> ''), 0)::double precision, 0) AS good_feedback_rate
FROM sent
LEFT JOIN feedback USING (user_id, job_id)
GROUP BY sent.source
ORDER BY good_feedback_rate DESC, feedback_count DESC, notifications_sent DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM users
WHERE is_pro = TRUE
  AND pro_expires_at > NOW();

SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS value
FROM users
WHERE is_pro = TRUE
  AND pro_expires_at IS NOT NULL
  AND pro_expires_at <= NOW();

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS activations
FROM product_events
WHERE event_type = 'pro_activated'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1d'), COUNT(*)::bigint AS renewals
FROM product_events
WHERE event_type = 'pro_renewed'
  AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Upgrade Funnel and Free Cap Pressure

targets.rawSql:
WITH viewed AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::bigint AS value
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'pro_upgrade_viewed'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), requested AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::bigint AS value
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'pro_upgrade_requested'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), activated AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::bigint AS value
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'pro_activated'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), cap_hits AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::bigint AS value
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'free_cap_hit'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
), hidden AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((properties->>'hidden_count')::bigint), 0)::bigint AS value
  FROM product_events
  WHERE event_type = 'free_hidden_by_cap'
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'pro_upgrade_viewed' AS metric, value FROM viewed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'pro_upgrade_requested' AS metric, value FROM requested
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'pro_activated' AS metric, value FROM activated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'free_cap_hit_users' AS metric, value FROM cap_hits
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'free_hidden_by_cap_leads' AS metric, value FROM hidden
) metrics;
